svg.aria-label: The GenAI stack I build with. Models: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Llama · Ollama, LiteLLM, Hugging Face. Orchestration: LangGraph, LangChain, Google ADK, MCP, Instructor, Pydantic. Retrieval: Qdrant, sqlite-vec, hybrid BM25 + dense, sentence-transformers. Ingestion: Docling, pdfplumber, Trafilatura, Tavily search. Evals & tracing: Langfuse, LangSmith, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, pytest evals. Serving: FastAPI, SSE streaming, Streamlit, Postgres, SQLite. Ml foundations: PyTorch, Transformers, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, OpenCV. Core: Python, C++, SQL, Git.
